decision: companyAuthorityWithoutProjectTemplate keys on every activeCompany fact except the Template, stage, applicability, review and Mission Plan grants: it filters those bundles out of grants and leaves out their legacy wire fields by name, unread, until #1334 removes them
why: Its consumers (Project Contracts, Documents, Lifecycle, Responsible) only serialize it as a remount key; keeping the legacy fields out preserves the no-remount behaviour while unmigrated fixtures still carry them

decision: A fixture grant keeps the captured version of its legacy fields and takes that version's registry permissions (Project v2, Client v2, Document Registrar v3 even when the legacy list was shorter); without a legacy version the smallest covering version is used (Project v1, Client v1, Template v1)
why: Keeps the captured assignment and version identical; the extra registry permissions (project.update, client.create, document.correct) are read by no migrated screen, and unmigrated screens still read the unchanged legacy fields

decision: A legacy fixture that held Project, Task or Client permissions without an assignment id gets a grant with a synthetic assignment id; where native UUID checks must keep refusing it (mission-plan.fixture actor) the id is non-native
why: A grant always carries a non-blank assignment; a non-native id preserves the earlier denial of native current work
